title: resourcerer
description: How resourcerer is doing across the cluster: savings, workloads, applies, load on Prometheus and health.

panels.title: Estimated savings / month
panels.description: Current minus recommended monthly cost, over every workload: what applying everything would change. Negative when the recommendations need more capacity than they free.

panels.title: Reclaimable / month
panels.description: What applying every recommendation that lowers requests would save; workloads that need more are not subtracted. The Overview's Reclaimable.

panels.title: Monthly cost now
panels.description: Requests × average replicas × rates × 730, summed over the managed workloads. Not the node bill: idle capacity and excluded namespaces are not in it.

panels.title: Ready
panels.description: Share of managed workloads whose recommendation can be applied with full history.

panels.title: Pending an apply
panels.description: Recommendations that differ from the requests by more than auto-deploy.threshold.

panels.title: Monthly cost: now and with the recommendations
panels.description: The distance between the lines is what applying everything would save.

targets.expr: sort_desc(sum by (namespace) (clamp_min(resourcerer_workload_monthly_cost{state="current", namespace=~"$namespace", workload_kind=~"$kind"} - ignoring(state) resourcerer_workload_monthly_cost{state="recommended", namespace=~"$namespace", workload_kind=~"$kind"}, 0)))

topk(15, sum by (namespace, workload_kind, workload) (clamp_min(resourcerer_workload_monthly_cost{state="current", namespace=~"$namespace", workload_kind=~"$kind"} - ignoring(state) resourcerer_workload_monthly_cost{state="recommended", namespace=~"$namespace", workload_kind=~"$kind"}, 0)))

panels.title: Workloads that need more capacity
panels.description: Recommendations that raise cost, usually to fix throttling or OOM kills.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (namespace, workload_kind, workload) (clamp_min(resourcerer_workload_monthly_cost{state="recommended", namespace=~"$namespace", workload_kind=~"$kind"} - ignoring(state) resourcerer_workload_monthly_cost{state="current", namespace=~"$namespace", workload_kind=~"$kind"}, 0)) > 0)

panels.title: CPU requested: now and with the recommendations
panels.description: Cores: requests × average replicas of the managed workloads, against what the nodes offer.

panels.title: Memory requested: now and with the recommendations
Cost rates in use
panels.description: Per core-hour (cpu) and GiB-hour (memory). Cost moving while requests stay flat is a price change, not rightsizing.

targets.expr: max by (resource) ((resourcerer_cost_rate) * on (instance) group_left () max by (instance, component) (resourcerer_build_info{component=~"controller|all"}))
max((resourcerer_cost_cluster_factor) * on (instance) group_left () max by (instance, component) (resourcerer_build_info{component=~"controller|all"}))

panels.title: Held by an apply policy / hour
Applies undone by another manager
panels.description: An applied recommendation whose values a GitOps sync, Helm or a person changed back. See the RecommendationOverwritten events.

panels.title: Samples / s by purpose
panels.description: What the queries cost Prometheus to evaluate and send.

panels.title: Failed queries / s by code
panels.description: error: no response; timeout: past prometheus.timeout.

targets.expr: sum by (component) ((rate(resourcerer_prometheus_response_bytes_total[5m])) * on (instance) group_left (component) max by (instance, component) (resourcerer_build_info))
sum by (component) ((resourcerer_prometheus_requests_in_flight) * on (instance) group_left (component) max by (instance, component) (resourcerer_build_info))

panels.title: Errors / s by route and code

targets.expr: count((up == 1) * on (instance) group_left () max by (instance, component) (resourcerer_build_info))

panels.title: Oldest recommendation
panels.description: Time since the stalest recommendation was computed. With the default @daily schedule, past a day and a half something is not refreshing.

panels.title: Least history
panels.description: The recommendation with the least usage history over its learning period.

panels.title: Cost calibration
panels.description: Where cost rates come from, and the state of the last calibration.

targets.expr: max by (source, state) ((resourcerer_cost_calibration) * on (instance) group_left () max by (instance, component) (resourcerer_build_info{component=~"controller|all"}))
sum((increase(controller_runtime_reconcile_errors_total[1h])) * on (instance) group_left () max by (instance, component) (resourcerer_build_info)) or vector(0)

panels.title: Recommendations computed / h by phase
panels.description: Only the reconciles that query Prometheus. Pending and Error back off up to the schedule.

panels.title: Time to compute one, p95 by kind

targets.expr: sum by (name) ((workqueue_depth) * on (instance) group_left () max by (instance, component) (resourcerer_build_info))
